name: Akita

sample.crs: CRS84; source catalog states JGD2011 conversion

source: Akita City registry-office map data published by Japan Ministry of Justice via G-space Information Center and converted by AIGID

queries.query: Akita City official cadastral map parcel GIS Japan
queries.result: Found Akita City’s official urban-planning map page and the Ministry of Justice/G-space catalog for Akita registry-office map data. The city viewer is a planning/reference system, while the national dataset is the evidenced parcel-map source.

queries.query: 秋田市 公式 地籍図 GIS 地番図 公図 不動産 登記 地図
queries.result: 秋田市公式GISを確認し、法務省の登記所備付地図データ（秋田市）と、G空間情報センターの秋田市変換済GeoJSONを確認した。変換済データは公共座標10系・JGD2011・CRS84で、筆ポリゴンと安定したIDを含む。

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Akita City Urban Planning Division / Akita City urban-planning GIS
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official city GIS provides urban-planning information and explicitly says it is approximate/reference information; its displayed topographic map is not a land-boundary map.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Japan Ministry of Justice, via G-space Information Center
officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: Akita City / Akita Legal Affairs Bureau jurisdiction
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official catalog dataset for Akita City registry-office map electronic data, with 2025 and 2026 XML resources; dataset spatial extent covers Akita Prefecture.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: AIGID / G-space Information Center conversion catalog
officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: Akita City public-coordinate registry-office map polygons
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Catalog describes mechanical conversion of Ministry of Justice data to GeoJSON, public-coordinate data only, JGD2011 conversion, and exposes 2026 GeoJSON resource.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: City GIS scope and limitations read; no parcel layer advertised.
Current viewer route fetched; returned WebGIS Administrator Login with guest-login control. No login, guest login, credentials, or private token used; no API request was attempted behind the wall.
Official catalog metadata returned Akita dataset and 2025/2026 XML resource URLs.
Conversion catalog returned 2022-2026 public-coordinate GeoJSON resources; 2026 resource URL identified.

Public GeoJSON downloaded to ignored scratch cache; parsed FeatureCollection contains 135,993 Polygon features, CRS84 declaration, and native ID properties. Three full polygons retained with only canonical id in GeoJSON.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Akita City registry-office map dataset published by the Ministry of Justice and its public-coordinate converted subset.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: 2026 public-coordinate GeoJSON resource, 135,993 Polygon features; bounded retained sample only.
coverageAssessment.registryExistenceScope: Official national registry-office map dataset and Akita City official GIS/procedure context evidenced; source is not a live local registry query endpoint.

qualityAssessment.geometryQuality: three full Polygon samples retained from public-coordinate conversion; no topology or positional accuracy assessment
qualityAssessment.crs: GeoJSON declares CRS84; catalog states conversion to JGD2011 public coordinate system / plane rectangular zone 10
qualityAssessment.identityReadiness: native source ID observed and retained as canonical id; source fields not retained
qualityAssessment.attributesRequested: Only native IDs and geometry were used for retained evidence; no owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax or account fields requested or retained.

blocker: Serial review must independently qualify source coverage semantics, ID stability, exact CRS/axis handling, and whether the mechanically converted registry-office map is admissible for runtime parcel use. The city GIS itself is explicitly a reference/planning map and not a boundary certificate.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [39.7224067708322,140.106157066224] preserved in latitude/longitude order and not shifted.
Retained sample is a bounded first-three-feature sample, not an exact-point hit and not evidence of citywide absence or completeness.
The official catalog data is registry-office map data, which may include map-like drawings as well as survey-grade maps; source semantics vary by map sheet.
No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS exception was used.
Packet completion is research evidence only and is not source integration/admission.
identityPolicy: Retained GeoJSON uses only the official converted-source ID as canonical id; native field names, mapping, catalog provenance, and source-specific attributes remain in this metadata.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently confirm ID stability, CRS/axis interpretation, coverage and legal/source semantics before any runtime adapter admission.
